bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; DEST="$ROOT/.worktrees/sticker-current"; test "$(git -C "$DEST" rev-parse HEAD)" = 4744dd1d4b092ca41f4104c427a65b154d9e83e6 || exit 43; if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DOCKER_CLI_UNAVAILABLE; exit 45; fi; if ! docker image inspect node:22-alpine >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo NODE22_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE_NO_PULL; exit 46; fi; docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev --security-opt no-new-privileges -v "$DEST:/work:ro" -w /work node:22-alpine node --test test/stickerWizard.test.mjs
